keep.text: Hours past 8 in one shift are overtime, paid at time and a half.
Shifts longer than 6 hours get a 5.00 meal allowance.

readme_rules.why: follows the out-of-date README: overtime at time and a half, Sunday double, a 5.00 meal allowance

weekend_double.why: pays both weekend days double, reading Saturday as an addition to the README's Sunday

meal_from_6_hours.why: off by one: gives the 2.39 allowance to a shift of exactly 6 hours, not only to longer ones

overtime_a_third.why: pays overtime a third extra (4/3) instead of 33% extra (1.33)
